description: 경상남도_산사태취약지역지정현황 [landslides and debris flows] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상남도. 산사태취약지역이란 「산림재난방지법」 제2조제9호에 따르면 산사태취약지역이란 산사태등으로 인하여 인명 및 재산 피해가 우려되는 지역으로서 같은 법 제22조에 따라 지정 또는 변경하여. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
